notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Attempt to draw card, instead choosing to mill 5 cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
If you milled a nonland card, The Wise Mothman triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card and discard Stinkweed Imp.
Repeat.
